history: Preserve the initial launcher substitution error, the two fixture harness corrections, and concurrent archive admission refusal. Sequential transfer recovery reused identical qualified source/plans. No scientific training or numerical tolerance changes.

python_tests.qualification: Four virtual CPU devices for group parity; existing B2 masked fixture rerun on a divisible two-device mesh. Direct Rust Go parity executable enabled for its previously skipped fixture.

candidate.scope: Exact states, losses, gradients, parameters, moments, sampler and updates at peak/warmup rates. Candidate additionally restores actual legacy checkpoints and checks Go-player inference. Engineering only; no TPU.

legacy.scope: Exact states, losses, gradients, parameters, moments, sampler and updates at peak/warmup rates. Candidate additionally restores actual legacy checkpoints and checks Go-player inference. Engineering only; no TPU.

rust_tests.scope: Workspace unit tests; the pre-existing optional long Go stress test was not requested.

scope: CPU engineering qualification only. It does not demonstrate improved Go learning or qualify TPU execution. Scientific trials must start fresh and use both registered arms.
